g.text: M3 = 100 stratified 50/50 supervised recalibration repeats (target labels consumed); whisker = percentile CI across repeats
Recalibration improves the slope only where discrimination existed
Probability accuracy (Brier / log-loss): M3 buys accuracy only in IMvigor210
M0 = prevalence-only; M2 = frozen S0; M3 = 100-repeat recalibration (whiskers = percentile CI across repeats).
GSE165252: M2 worse than M0 on both metrics; GSE78220: M2 ≈ M0 / M3 mixed despite AUC 0.615 — probability accuracy and discrimination separate.
